⇄How the two halves work

An engine that counts, a person who answers

One of them is good at pricing four hundred versions of your week. The other is the one you write to when the boat is cancelled.

⚙

The engine does the arithmetic

You give it people, dates and two figures. It prices every complete combination it can build and keeps the three that answer your rules.

  • Hundreds of combinations priced in full, not a filtered list
  • Children priced by age before you see the number, not after
  • Nothing padded to reach your maximum, nothing shown below your minimum
  • Every line re-checked with its own supplier before the page opens
✍

A licensed organiser answers

The trip is a contract with the agency, not a basket of separate bookings. One person knows your file and writes back.

  • Package Travel Directive protection on the whole trip
  • Compulsory traveller insurance included in what you paid
  • One card payment, one invoice, into the Italian system
  • Changes and cancellations handled by the person who sold it
✦Bookable on their own

①Three steps, no forms twice

How it works

Three steps, and none of them is a form you fill in twice.

1

Say what you can spend

People, dates, a range. Not a destination list and not a wishlist: the number is the brief.

2

Get three whole trips

Room, transfer and the good bits, priced together. Every line re-confirmed with its supplier before you see it.

3

Pay once, travel

One card payment to the agency. Vouchers by email, invoice into the Italian system, and a private area without a password.

One agency. One person answering.

Rimini Slow is a licensed travel organiser, not a booking aggregator. That means the trip is a contract with us, your money is protected by law, and when something changes you write to a person who knows your booking.

Licensed organiserCompulsory traveller insurance Margin VAT, art. 74-terInvoices through SDI
?Before you book

Before you book

Because without it the honest answer is always the cheapest possible week, and that is not what most people want. The lower figure tells the engine what a good trip looks like to you.

You get the full selling price of that line back, with no retention, and we rebook it if you want. The rule is in your voucher, per line, before you pay.

No. We send a link to your email and it opens your private area. Nothing to remember and nothing to reset.

Yes. Every component is sold on its own at the same price it carries inside a package. That is the first of the four rules.

Italian, English, German and French, from the first day. Emails, vouchers and invoices come in the language you booked in.

So, where are we going?

Give the engine three things: who is coming, when, and what you can spend. Three complete weeks come back, priced to the last euro, and nothing is charged until you say yes.
